name: Noah Moore
why: A Herald studio headshot of him alone, the only person in the frame, lit and posed. The chain of identification runs entirely through the Herald: the portrait is captioned with his name and is attached to his own tour-guide column, whose sign-off reads 'Features reporter Noah Moore'; the Herald's SGA reporting then names the same man in office, calling the newly appointed senator Noah Moore a features reporter for the Herald (14 Feb 2018) and 'Senator Noah Moore, who is also a reporter for the College Heights Herald' (11 Apr 2018). He is the archive's 2018-19 Director of Public Relations, an office the Herald also gives him (9 Apr 2019).

src.label: College Heights Herald, 27 February 2018, portrait accompanying his column 'Tour guide tell-all: Introduction to residence halls'

name: Paul Brosky
why: SGA's own official studio headshot of him, still served by the live WKU server at 960x960. Not cropped, not resized. The identification is WKU's own page, not a guess at a filename: the archived SGA executive branch page of 5 December 2019 places this exact image file beside the heading 'Paul Brosky', the office 'Director of Information Technology' and the address paul.brosky910@topper.wku.edu.
caption_quote: Paul Brosky, Director of Information Technology (headshot file paul.jpg on SGA's executive page)

src.label: WKU Student Government Association executive branch page, wku.edu/sga/executive (file /sga/executive/headshots/paul.jpg). Name-to-file pairing taken from the Internet Archive capture of that page, 5 December 2019.

name: John Winstead
why: The Herald's own staff mugshot of him, a single-subject frame shot against the Talisman shelves in the paper's office and re-run in fourteen issues from September 2015 to September 2016 — exactly his SGA year. Only one person is in the frame, so the caption cannot be misread onto anyone else. Cropped to head and shoulders from 1501x1001; not upscaled.

src.label: College Heights Herald, 3 September 2015, staff mugshot of John Winstead

name: Blake Bowden
why: A Herald studio portrait of him alone against a plain backdrop, sharp and strongly lit, made for the paper's feature on Black students and their hair. Only one person is in the frame. The caption's description of the hair — locs newly started on top, sides cut and faded — matches the photograph exactly, so caption and image are certainly the same subject. Cropped from 1501x1003; not upscaled. The tie to the archive's Blake Bowden is name plus campus plus period: the Herald puts a WKU student of that name on the Hill in the year on either side of his SGA service, and no second Blake Bowden appears anywhere in the paper's photo library.
caption_quote: Blake Bowden, 21, of Stone Mountain, Ga., has just recently started the locking process

src.label: College Heights Herald, 27 November 2017, studio portrait from the paper's feature on Black hair

name: Brian Anderson
why: A posed single-subject Herald portrait, suited, lit from the window of Gordon Wilson Hall. Only one person is in the frame, so the caption cannot attach to anyone else. It is a profile rather than a full-face view, but it is far the best-made picture of him the Herald holds. The 2015 date is before he reached SGA, and the link forward is the Herald's own: the same paper photographs 'Brian Anderson, sophomore from Hodgenville' at the campus surrogate debate of 1 November 2016, inside his year as Chair of Legislative Research, and Hodgenville is the seat of LaRue County, the school this portrait names. Cropped from 1501x999; not upscaled.
caption_quote: Brian Anderson, a senior from LaRue County High School, poses for a portrait in Gordon Wilson Hall

src.label: College Heights Herald, 10 February 2015, portrait by Emily Kask
